verdict.rationale: Pigment documents one-click scenarios for testing different assumptions (pigment-docs-11) and a configurable cash KPI such as projected year-end cash in budget planning (pigment-docs-10), so cash outcomes per scenario are plausible but only glancingly evidenced. The scenario evidence comes from the HR use case, and nothing ties scenarios to cash forecasts. Missing for 10: explicit burn-rate and runway calculations, per-scenario cash runway comparison, a computed zero-cash date, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
